title: phyllanthus pelas
intro: Phyllanthus pelas, commonly known as Cheesewood, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phyllanthus pelas include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Phyllanthus pelas have been reported to exhibit hepatoprotective, cardioprotective, and neuroprotective effects.
